# PDF editor regression fixtures

Generated by `tool/generate_pdf_editor_fixtures.py` using ReportLab and pypdf,
independently of the Dart engine under test. These files contain artificial
test content and published test passwords only.

| Fixture | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `form_rotated.pdf` | Two pages, embedded Roboto text including accented characters, a live text field, and a second page rotated 90 degrees. |
| `form_rotated_encrypted.pdf` | The same document protected with AES-256; the test verifies edits preserve the original password and encryption parameters. |
| `redaction.pdf` | A simple page text stream with a secret line and an untouched public line. |
| `partial_form.pdf` | An adversarial full-page Form XObject whose secret line is covered by a smaller redaction rectangle. Upstream retains the Form's bytes; the test records this known limitation. |

The expected values, test passwords, and PDF-space redaction rectangle are in
`manifest.json`. Roboto is already licensed and bundled by this repository;
see `assets/fonts/Roboto_LICENSE.txt`. The form's appearance and the simple
redaction cases use standard Helvetica.

## Run the checks

From the repository root, with Flutter 3.47.8 and Python available:

```sh
python -m pip install reportlab==4.4.9 pypdf==6.10.0 cryptography
python tool/verify_pdf_editor_outputs.py --fixtures-only
flutter test test/pdf_editor_round_trip_test.dart
python tool/verify_pdf_editor_outputs.py
```

The Dart tests write four output PDFs under `build/pdf_editor_verification`.
The Python verifier reads them with an independent parser and writes
`verification.json` only after all checks pass. It checks preserved page text,
embedded fonts, both the form tree and widget value/appearance, note location,
page order/rotation, password protection, and text-only redaction in extracted
text, raw bytes, every decoded stream, and revision history. A test rerun
deletes its previous outputs first so stale files cannot satisfy the verifier.

Regenerate inputs with `python tool/generate_pdf_editor_fixtures.py`. Plain
fixtures are deterministic for the pinned generator versions. The encrypted
fixture uses fresh AES salts and IVs, so equivalent regenerations have
different bytes. Check regenerated inputs with `--fixtures-only` before use.

## Scope of the redaction check

**Production redaction is disabled.** The text-only pass is evidence for that
specific engine path. It does not establish general safe redaction: upstream
leaves partially covered images and Form XObjects in the file beneath the
fill, and it does not recursively split a Form's internal content. The
adversarial fixture deliberately proves recoverable hidden text remains in
that case. If an upstream upgrade fixes it, update the expected limitation
only after broader security review and regression coverage.

Render output PDFs with Poppler or a separate viewer when reviewing visible
layout; parser checks alone do not detect every rendering defect. Native
Keychain/Keystore behavior and arbitrary real-world PDFs are outside this
small integration suite.
